title: Graded algebra and degree-zero generated action on formal-system kernels
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], $I$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, and $F$ a coherent formal module [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Use the associated graded pieces $B_n=I^n/I^{n+1}$, kernels $K_n$ and inclusions of [def-weil-pbc-formal-kernel-graded-pieces], with $K_0=F_1$. There exist a graded sheaf algebra $A$ on $B$ and a graded sheaf module $M$ on $K$ [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures] such that the unit is the degree-zero quotient projection, multiplication is induced by multiplying representatives in the ideal powers, and $M$ is locally generated by finitely many degree-zero sections. More explicitly, for every open $U$, degrees $m,n$, and sections $a$ of $I^m$, $b$ of $I^n$, there is $c$ in $I^{m+n}(U)$ whose inclusion in $\mathcal O_X(U)$ is $ab$ and such that $A.mul(\bar a,\bar b)=\bar c$. For every $x\in K_n(U)$ and every lift $t\in F_{m+n+1}(U)$ of its inclusion in $F_{n+1}(U)$, the inclusion of $M.act(\bar a,x)$ in $F_{m+n+1}(U)$ equals $at$. Local degree-zero generation means precisely the local finite-sum predicate of [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures].

source.place: Lemma 087Z affine proof via 087W; Section 0EHN. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087Z and /087W.

proof.text: Construct multiplication and the action by local lifts; independence follows because all errors lie in I^(m+n+1) F_(m+n+1), which is zero. Bilinearity and restriction compatibility allow gluing. Verify the unit, associativity and commutativity on common representatives at one sufficiently high level. Iterated ideal multiplication supplies the global section c for actual power-ideal sections.

On an affine neighbourhood, identify the formal system with the quotients of its finite completion module N. Ideal-product and quotient sections identify B_n and K_n with the sheaves associated to I^n/I^(n+1) and I^n N/I^(n+1) N. The local-lift formulas identify the graded operations with multiplication of module representatives.

Choose finitely many generators of N/IN. The completed-module associated-graded generator theorem makes the finite sum of copies of the graded algebra surject onto each graded module piece. Applying tilde preserves these epimorphisms. Their sheaf-local surjectivity gives exactly the finite coefficient sections required by the degree-zero local generation predicate, for arbitrary smaller opens and points.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 087Z affine proof via 087W; lift independence, homogeneous laws and local generation expanded by Q4.

mathlib_searches.results: IsModuleFiltration.toGradedSMul, Ideal.Filtration.submodule and AdicCompletion operations describe algebraic filtrations; none constructs this sheaf graded action or its local finite generation.
GradedAlgebra and DirectSum.decomposeAlgEquiv concern graded submodules of a fixed algebra, not these sheaf quotient pieces and formal kernels.

Mathlib RingTheory/ReesAlgebra and Filtration provide algebraic Rees constructions, not graded sheaf operations on a formal module. Direct rg of lean/Sheaf and WeilConjectures found no existing graded construction besides the original holed item.

lean.statement:
theorem formalSystems_kernel_rees_finite_exists {X : Scheme.{ut}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F : CoherentFormalModule X I) :
    ∃ A : GradedSheafAlgebra (formalAssociatedGradedPiece I),
      A.unit = formalAssociatedGradedπ I 0 ∧
      (∀ (m n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens)
        (a : (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).1.val.obj (op U))
        (b : (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).1.val.obj (op U)),
        ∃ c : (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι (m + n)).1.val.obj (op U),
          (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι (m + n)).2.val.app (op U) c =
            (@id Γ(X, U) ((Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).2.val.app (op U) a)) *
              (@id Γ(X, U) ((Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2.val.app (op U) b)) ∧
          A.mul m n U ((formalAssociatedGradedπ I m).val.app (op U) a)
            ((formalAssociatedGradedπ I n).val.app (op U) b) =
              (formalAssociatedGradedπ I (m + n)).val.app (op U) c) ∧
      ∃ M : GradedSheafModule A (formalKernelPiece F),
        M.IsLocallyGeneratedInDegreeZero ∧
        ∀ (m n : ℕ) (U : X.Opens)
          (a : (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).1.val.obj (op U))
          (x : (formalKernelPiece F n).val.obj (op U))
          (t : (F.obj.obj (op (m + n))).val.obj (op U)),
          (F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_left n m)).op).val.app (op U) t =
            (formalKernelι F n).val.app (op U) x →
          (formalKernelι F (m + n)).val.app (op U)
            (M.act m n U ((formalAssociatedGradedπ I m).val.app (op U) a) x) =
              (@id Γ(X, U) ((Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι m).2.val.app (op U) a)) • t
